details.method: For a no-tools data consumer, explicitly bind the producer to the typed payload schema and retain bounded stage-specific diagnostics before temporary output cleanup. Verify the real producer receives the schema, not only a parser helper. Derive offsets only from structured parser fields; quoted exception messages are untrusted. Check UTF-8 validity both before and after JSON decoding. Observe the current interpreter independently before asserting a parser-limit stage. A fixed syntactically valid stress input may instead reach safe schema rejection. Exercise defensive exception branches separately with an exact-payload fault after the real adapter callback.
details.when: A successful transport envelope contains an unconstrained string that a downstream consumer must parse as a separate strict data document.
details.counterexample: Ordinary chat intentionally returns prose and action envelopes, while routing uses a different data schema. Do not apply a requirements schema to all no-tools calls; do not infer the parse layer of an old failure whose raw output is gone. A parser can accept escaped invalid Unicode even when the original wire is ASCII; runtime C decoder depth limits can differ from Python recursion settings. PR1073 Python3.15.2 accepted 10,000 nested arrays that Python3.12.14 rejects; Python3.14.3 also accepts this input. A locally proven depth limit is not a portable CI precondition.
details.trial_plan: On a future pre-registered cross-runtime isolated trial, retain fixed deep-array, long-integer and invalid-Unicode inputs. Independently observe each runtime decoder, then require exact intake parser-stage or schema-stage rejection, with fixed private diagnostics, known adapter-call boundary and no publication. Independently inject RecursionError and integer-limit ValueError for the exact returned raw payload; delegate other JSON loads to the real parser. Also exercise malformed quoted-position data and valid typed/shared-chat controls. Do not infer a limit from a previous runtime, skip an accepting runtime, enlarge depth until it fails or retrospectively mark this revision verified.
